4. New Observation: The background trees and building lines show slight warping/inconsistency typical of AI generation, but it's subtle. The overall lighting is consistent. The artifact score should reflect the text failure as the primary defect.

All visible diagnostic checkpoints (silhouette, lights, markings, windows) are present and correct. The only missing element (rear doors) is due to camera angle, not generation failure. artifact_reasoning: The primary artifact is text gibberish on the side and license plate, confirmed by the image_text_auditor's failure to extract any readable text. This is a common AI weakness and warrants a moderate penalty. Secondary artifacts include slight softness/melting in the front grille logo and headlight details, and minor geometric irregularity in the front wheel arch. These are noticeable but do not compromise the overall structural integrity. The topology mask was clean, ruling out severe fusion. The perceptual quality auditor found no global noise or blur issues. The artifact score is lowered from the base reference due to the definitive text failure and minor mechanical detailing issues.
